weightTable.title: Poids de Scoring par Type de Projet
weightTable.subtitle: These are the weights the scoring service applies, in full. Which column a project gets depends on whether it has a tradeable token: with a token, ten dimensions are weighted; without one, the six that need token data cannot be measured at all, so three remain.
weightTable.footnote: A dimension we cannot measure for a given project is skipped rather than scored zero, and the weights of the dimensions that remain are divided by their own sum. A missing dimension therefore raises the share every other dimension carries; it never drags the score down by itself. If no dimension can be measured, no overall score is published.

scoring.subtitle: Every dimension is scored 0 to 100, multiplied by its published weight and divided by the weights we were able to use. The weights are fixed constants. They change when we change them and ship a new version, not while an audit is running.

weightDistribution.title: Weight Distribution (Project With a Token)
weightDistribution.description: The five dimensions below carry 75 of the 100 points available to a project with a token. The remaining 25 sit in the on-chain behaviour metrics listed in the full table further down.

calculationExample.title: Exemple de Calcul
calculationExample.comment: // Illustration only. A project with a token, every dimension measured.
calculationExample.renormalisationDescription: The worked example above assumes all ten dimensions produced a score. In practice some of them often cannot: a contract whose source is unverified yields no code score, a token with no holder history yields no whale dump risk score. Those dimensions are dropped, and the weights of the ones that remain are divided by their own sum so they still add up to 100. Nothing is scored zero for being unmeasurable.
calculationExample.renormalisationTitle: When a dimension cannot be measured

weightChanges.description: Nothing tunes the weights per project and nothing adjusts them while an audit runs. They change only when we publish a new version of the scoring service, and the table on this page changes with it. Between versions we collect:

inputs.communityRatings: Community ratings, weighted by the reviewer's experience tier
inputs.externalAudits: Professional audit reports imported for projects we have already scored
inputs.reviewComments: The comments submitted alongside those ratings

metadata.title: The Multi-Dimensional Security Audit Framework | Spectra Audit
metadata.description: How Spectra Audit scores smart contracts across code, distribution, tokenomics, liquidity, sentiment, and on-chain behaviour, in one transparent Security Score backed by verifiable evidence.

methodology.title: Processus d'Audit de Pointe
methodology.subtitle: Every audit runs on a sandboxed fork of the blockchain. No live transactions, and no risk to user funds during analysis.

forkTesting.title: Simulation Basée sur Fork
forkTesting.description: Les interactions de contrats intelligents sont rejouées sur un fork isolé du mainnet. Nous observons le comportement sans jamais diffuser de transactions sur le réseau en direct.

aiOrchestration.title: Analyse Orchestrée par IA
aiOrchestration.description: Multiple specialized AI agents coordinate across code review, economic modeling, and on-chain data, producing findings no single analyzer could surface alone.

staticAnalysis.title: Analyse Statique de Bytecode et ABI
staticAnalysis.description: Notre scanner inspecte directement le bytecode compilé et les ABI, permettant l'analyse de contrats même lorsque le code source est indisponible ou partiellement vérifié.

multiDimensional.title: Multi-Dimensional Scoring
multiDimensional.description: Code, Distribution, Tokenomics, Liquidity, and Sentiment are scored independently in parallel, then weighted into a composite security score.

diagram.ariaLabel: Parallel audit pipeline. The deep-analysis analyzers (Code, Distribution, Tokenomics, Liquidity, and Sentiment) run concurrently and converge, with the on-chain behaviour metrics, into a single composite security score.
diagram.subtitle: Analyzers running in parallel → weighted composite

learningLoop.title: Comment le Score Spectra S’améliore avec le Temps
learningLoop.subtitle: Feedback and comparisons against past audits are collected and reviewed, and they shape the next version of the model. They do not change a score that has already been published.

userFeedback.title: Intégration des Retours Utilisateurs
userFeedback.description: Community ratings and expert reviews on every finding are recorded, weighted by the reviewer's experience tier. Reports of false positives, missed vulnerabilities and disputed severities are reviewed by us before the next release.

calibration.title: Calibration par Rapport aux Projets Similaires
calibration.description: Each new audit is cross-referenced against historical audits of structurally similar contracts and tokenomics. What that comparison turns up is reviewed by us. It does not move a published score on its own.

aiOptimization.title: Model Updates
aiOptimization.description: As new exploit patterns emerge on-chain and new vulnerability classes are disclosed, the model is updated and a new version is released. Past scores are not rewritten. A project gets a new score when it is analysed again.

externalAudits.title: Référence Croisée avec Audits Externes
externalAudits.description: When professional human audits become available for a project, our findings are compared against the report. Discrepancies are recorded and reviewed before the next release.

diagram.ariaLabel: Boucle de rétroaction d'amélioration continue en forme de bouclier : les audits alimentent les retours des utilisateurs, qui sont pondérés selon la réputation de l'évaluateur lors de l'évaluation, puis utilisés pour calibrer et mettre à jour le modèle pour une version future.

disclaimer.title: Avertissement Important
disclaimer.aiGenerated: All findings are produced by AI analysis, not by human security auditors.
disclaimer.forkTesting: Le comportement des contrats est analysé sur une réplique forkée de la blockchain, pas sur le mainnet en direct.
disclaimer.noGuarantee: Un score de sécurité élevé NE garantit PAS qu'un projet est sûr. Les scores reflètent l'état des données disponibles au moment de l'analyse.
disclaimer.doYourResearch: Effectuez toujours vos propres recherches (DYOR) avant de prendre toute décision d'investissement, de déploiement ou d'intégration.
disclaimer.toolPurpose: Spectra Audit est un outil informatif conçu pour aider les utilisateurs à comprendre les considérations de sécurité derrière un projet. Il ne constitue pas un conseil financier, juridique ou d'investissement.
disclaimer.beta: Spectra Audit is in beta. The platform, the scoring model and the weights behind it are still changing, and a score produced today may not match one produced later for the same project.

faq.title: Questions fréquentes
faq.q1: Combien de temps dure un audit de smart contract ?
faq.a1: Spectra Audit termine la plupart des audits en 20 minutes ou moins, contre des jours, voire des semaines, pour un audit manuel traditionnel.
faq.q2: Quels types de vulnérabilités Spectra Audit peut-il détecter ?
faq.a2: Spectra Audit détecte plus de 15 catégories de vulnérabilités, dont la réentrance, les dépassements (overflow/underflow), les défauts de contrôle d'accès et les vecteurs d'attaque économiques.
faq.q3: L'audit de sécurité de Spectra Audit est-il vraiment gratuit ?
faq.a3: Oui. Spectra Audit propose des audits de sécurité complets et gratuits, sans carte bancaire. Des fonctionnalités premium sont disponibles pour la surveillance avancée.
faq.q4: Quelle est la précision des résultats de Spectra Audit ?
faq.a4: We publish no detection-rate figure, because we have not benchmarked one. What we can tell you is how the findings are produced: by AI analysis rather than by human auditors, each one rated by severity and shipped with the evidence behind it so you can check it yourself. Results are informational and do not guarantee that a project is safe.
faq.q5: Spectra Audit prend-il en charge plusieurs blockchains ?
faq.a5: Oui. Spectra Audit prend en charge Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism et d'autres blockchains compatibles EVM.
